top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Fed-Hike Bets Boost Treasury Yields: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The last stretch of a busy week for markets saw stocks falling as bond yields rose, with traders also facing the expiration of a pile of options that threatens to trigger sudden price swings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: GLP-1, adolescentes y redes sociales
top_signals.summary: Adolescentes cuentan que los GLP-1 aparecen por todas partes en sus redes. Médicos alertan que la presión por adelgazar, las imitaciones online y los vacíos de control pueden agravar trastornos alimentarios. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: European Commission set to push social media restrictions, safety requirements into law
top_signals.summary: The proposal, known as the EU KIDS Act, would block social media platforms from offering accounts to children younger than 13 and establish a bloc-wide minimum age of 15 for account creation.
